commitMessage:
Informative users page with role tabs and sortable columns; reseller tweaks

- Users: tabs per account type with counts (admin), avatar with name,
  email and phone, coloured account-type chip, details column (which
  reseller manages a customer, or a reseller's customer quota), account
  status (active, expiring within 7 days, expired, disabled), account
  validity, consent status against the current EULA version, devices.
  Click a column title to sort ascending/descending; tab and sort are
  remembered. All accounts are loaded at once, 100 rows shown at a time.
- 'Masuk' (login as user) is now labelled 'Impersonate'.
- Resellers no longer see the 'Aturan & Otomasi' settings group.
- New device form for admins and resellers has an optional 'Pelanggan
  (pemilik)' field that links the device to that customer on save.
